abstract: The purposes of this study were to evaluate the prevalence and imaging characteristics of ovarian teratomas that appear as solid masses on ultrasonography and to compare the ultrasonographic imaging features of the tumors with their pathologic findings. The ultrasonographic images of 202 ovarian teratomas were reviewed retrospectively. Solid-appearing masses were selected from among them and were evaluated in terms of internal echotexture, the presence or lack of peripheral hypoechogenicity, posterior sonic attenuation, and tumoral calcification. Seventy-six (37.6%) masses of 202 belonged to the atypical solid-appearing masses on ultrasonography. Of 76 masses, 57 (75.0%) had peripheral hypoechogenicity; 38 masses had well-defined thin hypoechoic rims, whereas 19 had poorly demarcated peripheral hypoechogenicity. Posterior sonic attenuation was evident in 18 (23.7%) masses. The presence of peripheral hypoechogenicity, which is suggestive of the fluid portion of the tumor, might be one of the characteristic findings of solid-appearing ovarian teratomas on ultrasonography.
abstract_ja: 本研究の目的は、超音波検査上充実性に見える卵巣奇形腫の有病率と画像特徴を評価し、画像所見を病理所見と比較することであった。卵巣奇形腫202例の超音波画像を後方視的に検討した。充実性に見える腫瘤を抽出し、内部エコーの性状、辺縁低エコーの有無、後方音響陰影、腫瘍内石灰化について評価した。202例中76例（37.6%）が非典型的な充実性像を示す腫瘤であった。76例中57例（75.0%）に辺縁低エコーがみられ、38例は明瞭で細い低エコー性の縁取りを、19例は境界不明瞭な辺縁低エコーを有していた。後方音響陰影は18例（23.7%）で認められた。腫瘍の液体成分を示唆する辺縁低エコーの存在は、超音波検査における充実性卵巣奇形腫の特徴的所見の一つとなりうる。
